item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli settlers are attacking Palestinians harvesting olives in the West Bank, torching cars and trees and wounding several farmers, while a Washington Post photographer and a New York Times journalist were also targeted. The son of the Israeli ambassador was critically injured in a separate West Bank attack. Azerbaijan hosted a rare summit that brought together Israeli and Palestinian representatives alongside other regional leaders. Two container ships sank near the Strait of Hormuz amid heightened Iranian attacks linked to the Gaza conflict. The UCDP recorded 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
